name: Medplus Health Services Ltd
keyPoints: India's Leading Pharmacy Company[1][2] MedPlus is the 2nd largest pharmacy retailer in India, with 4,930 stores across 13 states and 1 union territory, serving 750 cities as of Q2 FY26. These stores are strategically distributed to maintain a high presence in metro, tier-one, and tier-two cities. Store Distribution by Region[2] Telangana: 781 stores Andhra Pradesh: 569 stores Karnataka: 997 stores Tamil Nadu: 1014 stores West Bengal: 691 stores Maharashtra: 587 stores Odisha: 179 stores Chhattisgarh: 45 stores Madhya Pradesh: 33 stores Puducherry: 5 stores Delhi: 1 store They added 218 net new stores in H1 FY2026, of which 121 were in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities. 28 stores were closed in Q2 FY26, out of which 13 closed due to relocation, 5 closed due to franchisee withdrawal, 10 closed due to other reasons.[3][4]
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 28.4% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 3.55 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 8.38% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged 74.1% of their holding.
